Placemaker.Golf.Name: Golf
Placemaker.Recipe.Golf.Description: Golf fitted to your area: real hole routing with tees, fairways, doglegs, greens, bunkers and water, or pitch & putt, mini golf, a driving range or disc golf.
Placemaker.Golf.subtype.Tooltip: What kind of golf: a full course, short pitch & putt, mini golf lanes, a driving range or a disc golf course.
Placemaker.Golf.holes.Tooltip: How many holes to route. Fewer are built when the area runs out of room (the summary says how many fit).
Placemaker.Golf.holeLength.Tooltip: Average tee-to-green length. Holes vary around it (short par 3s, long par 5s) and shrink where space is tight. Each format keeps its own sensible range.
Placemaker.Golf.doglegs.Tooltip: Share of holes that bend left or right on the way to the green.
Placemaker.Golf.routing.Tooltip: Loop: the last holes come back to the clubhouse. Out and back: the front nine heads out, the back nine returns. Free: holes go wherever they fit best.
Placemaker.Golf.bunkers.Tooltip: Sand bunkers per hole: greenside first, then fairway bunkers in the landing zone (outside of doglegs). Sunk into the ground.
Placemaker.Golf.water.Tooltip: Ponds beside fairways and greens. They permanently lower the terrain and fill with water.
Placemaker.Golf.fairwayWidth.Tooltip: Width of the fairway corridor; the mown fairway is a little narrower and tapers at both ends.
Placemaker.Golf.teeBoxes.Tooltip: Tee boxes per hole, stepped back behind each other (forward, middle and back tees).
Placemaker.Golf.shapeGreens.Tooltip: Lifts greens and tee boxes slightly above the ground (permanent terrain change).
Placemaker.Golf.cartPaths.Tooltip: Wide paths beside every hole, linked from green to next tee. Off: footpaths from green to tee only.
Placemaker.Golf.clubhouse.Tooltip: Clubhouse (or ticket kiosk / starter hut) by the main entrance, with parked golf carts.
Placemaker.Golf.treeDensity.Tooltip: Trees in the rough between the holes. Parkland courses are wooded, links courses are open.
Placemaker.Golf.roughPaint.Tooltip: Paints the rough with a terrain texture so the mown fairways stand out (permanent).
Placemaker.Golf.roughLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the rough is painted with.
Placemaker.Golf.miniTheme.Tooltip: Adventure: rocks and a pond. Garden: flowerbeds beside the lanes. Classic: a low fence, lamps and benches.
Placemaker.Golf.bays.Tooltip: Bays along the covered tee line. Limited by the width of the area.
Placemaker.Golf.shopLayout.Tooltip: A continuous band along the street, or separate shop pads.
Placemaker.Golf.shopDepth.Tooltip: Depth of the commercial band (one zone cell is 8 m).
Placemaker.Golf.Issue.FewerHoles: Only {0} of {1} holes fit in this area.
Placemaker.Golf.Issue.NoHoles: No hole fits in this area: make it larger or choose a shorter format.
Placemaker.Golf.Feature.practiceGreen.To: A putting green with several cups and a chipping bunker next to the clubhouse.
Placemaker.AddOn.PuttingGreen.Name: Putting green
Placemaker.AddOn.PuttingGreen.size.Toolt: Diameter of the green. It shrinks to fit when the space is small.
Placemaker.AddOn.PuttingGreen.bunker.Too: A small sand bunker beside the green to practise chipping.
